changesMade: hero.module.css: added display-face mass compensation on .headline - font-weight 750 (named --hero-display-fallback-weight) instead of the drawn 450. Mechanism: Exposure/Exposure-20 is licensed with no WOFF2 in the repo, so --font-display falls through to Newsreader, a high-contrast Didone with much thinner stems that also sets ~10% narrow. Newsreader is loaded as a variable font (wght 200-800), so the missing mass is bought back on the weight axis and the drawn -0.04em tracking token is left untouched. Weight picked by measuring glyph advances straight out of the subset WOFF2 on disk (fontTools, per-weight instance, at the drawn 108px/-0.04em): 'AI compute at' 600.7px (-10.9%) -> 659.0px (-2.2%) vs Figma 674px, and 'the maritime edge.' 786.9px (-8.3%) -> 862.9px (+0.6%) vs Figma 858px. The 450 row reproduces the reviewer's measured 603px/781px to within 0.5%, so the model is calibrated.

hero-stage.client.tsx: title block inset is now px-3 below the tablet frame (md:px-6 restores 24px from 768 up, lg:px-0 unchanged). Mechanism: the corrected mass widens 'AI compute at the' from ~308px to 338px at the 44px mobile display size; a 24px inset leaves a 318px measure, so the line would have reflowed onto a third line and orphaned 'edge.'. A 12px inset leaves 342px and preserves the two balanced mobile lines (338px / 282px).
summary: Closed the dominant CRITICAL at all three breakpoints by raising the fallback display face to a measured weight 750, which puts the headline's stem mass and line widths within ~2% of Figma's Exposure without touching the drawn tracking token, and widened the mobile title measure so the heavier face keeps its two-line composition.
notFixed: Exposure/Matter WOFF2s themselves: the faces are licensed, no file exists in the repo, and the stacks + tokens live in src/app/fonts.ts and src/app/globals.css - shared files owned by other agents this pass. The compensation above should be lifted onto --text-display-xl--font-weight in globals.css (it applies to every display heading on the page, not just the hero) once the real face ships or is ruled out.

Lead paragraph wrapping to 5 instead of 4 lines (Matter -> Inter is ~7.8% wider) and the resulting 30px CTA offset: same missing-font root cause but a different axis - Inter has no width axis, so the only levers are the shared font stack or widening the drawn 431px lead column. Left for a focused pass rather than shotgunning it alongside the display fix.
Vessel plate tone (sails render as solid mid-blue rather than hazed blue-white): the fix is a re-export of hero-vessel.png. Binary assets are off-limits this pass and any change to them is reverted.
